World-Class Campus Infrastructure

A sprawling 5-acre modern ecosystem designed for curious minds, featuring high-tech composite labs, athletic courts, library, and central atrium.

5-Acre Eco-Friendly Campus Digital STEM & Cyber Labs Full-Scale Sports Arena 24/7 Monitored Safe Campus
Campus & Amenities

World-Class Campus Infrastructure

Spread across 5 sprawling acres in Hopefarm, our purpose-built campus provides a secure, stimulating, and technologically enriched atmosphere designed for 21st-century learners.

Day Care & Early Care

Day Care Facility

A safe, joyful, and nurturing space equipped with colorful interactive learning zones, story corners, and certified caregiver supervision to support healthy early childhood growth and play.

Ergonomic Classrooms

Smart Classrooms

Spacious, well-ventilated learning spaces equipped with crescent collaborative seating, digital boards, and technology to facilitate an engaging, active learning experience.

5,000+ Titles

Library

A serene, expansive Library housing an extensive collection of over 5,000+ curated volumes, reference encyclopedias, periodicals, and quiet reading spaces. It serves as the academic cornerstone for research, literature exploration, and independent study, cultivating a lifelong passion for reading.

Composite Science Lab

Composite Science Lab

State-of-the-art Composite Science Lab designed to foster scientific curiosity and hands-on discovery. Complemented by specialized facilities including a dedicated Nursery Lab, Math Lab, Activity Lab, and Hydrophonic Lab, equipping students with practical, enquiry-based learning across experiential disciplines.

Indoor Sports Arena

Sport & Court Facilities

State-of-the-art facilities designed to promote physical literacy, indoor and outdoor court play, and sportsmanship. Features line-marked courts for Basketball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Athletics, and martial arts.

Welcome Lounge

Campus Reception & Lobby

An expansive, sunlit reception lobby and welcome lounge featuring contemporary seating, counselling suites, and an administrative hub to receive visiting parents, students, and guests.

Medical & Care

Infirmary

A fully equipped campus Infirmary dedicated to student health, wellness, and prompt medical attention. Staffed by a qualified medical professional for immediate first aid, routine health checks, emergency care, and complete student medical well-being.

Central Atrium

Central Atrium

A magnificent, multi-storey naturally lit central Atrium with four-tier balconies and house banners. Serves as a dynamic gathering space for morning assemblies, investitures, cultural showcases, and celebrations.

Dance Studio

Dance Studio

A dedicated, purpose-built Dance Studio equipped with specialised wooden sprung flooring, full-length rehearsal mirrors, and professional audio systems for classical and contemporary dance instruction, rehearsals, and creative self-expression.

GPS Enabled

GPS-Enabled Transport

A secure, comprehensive, and technologically monitored bus service covering key routes in the Hopefarm / East Bangalore area. Managed by experienced staff with real-time GPS tracking and mandatory adult supervision.

Amphitheatre Hall

Ceremonial Amphitheatre & Hall

A grand indoor amphitheatre and multipurpose ceremonial arena with expansive seating layout, central red carpet, and acoustic design. Hosts major institutional milestones, the Student Council Investiture, and keynote assemblies.
